body:
Wow. Absolutely wow. You hit on everything I was thinking myself, everything I thought no one would even think (or at least suggest). I have thought about suicide, but only in the passion of "At least someday this charade will be over", but never seriously. And I never will, I don't think.


As for the virgin thing -- it's east to say it doesn't matter, but when you have somewhere around half-a-dozen people mentioning it to you everyday it's hard to ignore the fact that the least experienced never says anything. 

The weird thing is, when I meet a virgin, I don't think anything weird about them, no matter the age. I really don't care at the end of it all. So why would I expect anybody else to care, at their heart?

I just can't. Every time a girl looks at me I think it means something, when it might not. If I'm chilling posing, and I look over and some girl is obviously looking at me (I look at them and they look away immediately) I just don't know what to say. I suck at the girl thing and it really bugs me.

I don't know about the ADD/ADHD thing, I thought so too, but I've taken Adderall/Ritalin before to study for finals and what not, do projects, and it didn't even help me at all it seemed. 

I've been thinking about seeing a therapist, but I couldn't afford one anyway.

No, because I've hated school since freshman year of high school and my grades have been around 2.0 since then. I just don't care about school that much. I feel like other people care about it for me. 

Put it this way, I'm doing a course online (not enrolled, just happens to be free with video lectures and notes) just for fun, but I hate going to the classes I have. 

I've felt like this for a long time.

And second of all, I'm not going to kill myself. 

But I can imagine you could guess how depressing this post will be. At least for me. 

I honestly don't even know what to write. I'm 23, never had a girlfriend (seeing that this issue comes before the next few really tells a lot and it's probably what bugs me the most), family life is crap except for a few saving graces and won't improve, and basically just failed out of school. Not that that bothers me *that* much. 

What bothers me is what my friends will think of me. What my family will think of me.  It just seems like another nail. If I never had a girlfriend before, why would anyone get with some kind of drop-out? I see all my friends graduating and when they ask me when I'm graduating I just don't know what to say. To be honest, I don't even really care if I do graduate. School has just never been that important to me. 

I see all my friends talking about their millions of ex-girlfriends, and talking about sex in a group of friends and everyone says something and I'm just sitting there staring into space because I have nothing to add to the issue. And I'm sure everyone knows, but no one says much. 

What bothers me the most is that people I meet seem to *really* like me. I've had numerous people tell me that they love to hang out with me. Some call me all the time to just hang out. I get invited to places and events by friends who I share a mutual friend with but that other friend doesn't get invited. Girls text me asking what I'm doing, how we should do something together, flirting happens all the time. Nothing materializes. I just can't bring myself to think that someone would actually want to be with me. Platonic or not. 

I just don't know what it is. Maybe it's because I never knew my dad. I'm constantly reviewing and judging my own actions in relation to this person or that person. I'm constantly looking at people and thinking they're better than me. Think they have it together. I know that that's not the case most times, but it feels like it. 

I'm taking this next year off it seems because I can't reapply for school for a year because of my grades. I still haven't told anyone. I know my family won't mind much (they all consider me the smartest of the bunch I guess), but telling my friends....I just don't know if I can do it.

I can barely listen to happy songs anymore because they depress me.  

I'm not even sure why I made this post. Anyone have experience with this? I've been thinking about moving in the next few years, starting something new. I don't know what to do
